name: How do I choose the right screen material for my sliding door?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right screen material for my sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right screen material depends on your specific needs. If pest control and basic ventilation are priorities, fiberglass is a common, affordable choice. For homes with pets, pet-resistant screens offer enhanced durability against claws. Aluminum screens provide greater strength and a clearer view. If you're looking to reduce sun glare and heat, solar screens are an effective option. Consider your local climate, sun exposure, and household activity when making your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select screen material based on needs like pet resistance, sun control, clear visibility, or basic insect protection.
